essence: The mantra's vivification may be performed by reciting it either one hundred times or ten times.
The striking of the mantra is considered valid when done a hundred times.
After the preceding steps, one should awaken the mantra.
One should strike with the repha as many times as there are syllables in the mantra to effect awakening.
The act in question is affirmed to be satiation.
